title: Philter Policy
description: Minimal validation schema for a Philter PII/PHI redaction policy. Permissive on additional properties so policies remain forward-compatible with new Philter releases.

name.description: Policy identifier — referenced when calling the Philter API.

config.description: Optional engine configuration (text splitting, encryption keys, etc.).

ignored.description: Terms the policy should not redact even when detected as an entity.

identifiers.description: Map of entity-type configurations. Each key is an entity type (age, ssn, creditCard, etc.); each value declares one or more filter strategies.
